messages:
tariq: compliance pinged — they need a tamper-evident mapping from audit rows to humans. right now many rows just show service callers (svc:*). can we ship something low-risk to reduce legal tickets?

mei: quick example from a support export:
```
{
  "ts": 1717001111,
  "tenant": "retailco",
  "event": "policy.update",
  "actor": "svc:rule-router",
  "meta": {}
}
```

lucy: idea: attach a signed `resolution_manifest.json` alongside the NDJSON bundle. manifest lists every distinct actor_raw -> resolved_user (or null) with provenance (method=cache|api|heuristic) and a resolver_version. sign manifest with service key so we can verify later.

kevin: infrastructure concerns: doing live resolution for 500k unique actors in a big export will hammer identity-service and gen big egress costs. prefer background dedup+batch lookup with backoff and a separate internal quota.

identity-svc: +1 on batch endpoint. we can add POST /v1/lookup/batch { ids: [...] } returning map and also a dry-run mode for telemetry. TTL on cache should be configurable.

mei: UX: export modal should show three states: exporting, manifest-generating, complete-with-manifest. if manifest-generating, allow user to download NDJSON immediately and get manifest later by email or console link. show small warning icon if unresolved_count > 0. copy: "Actor resolution underway — some rows map to service identities. Manifest will be attached when ready."

lucy: telemetry we need: export.size_rows, export.distinct_actor_raw, manifest.resolve.start_ts, manifest.resolve.end_ts, manifest.resolve.method_counts, manifest.unresolved_count, identity_api_calls. histograms for latency and extra API calls per 1000 rows.

kevin: quota semantics: background manifest jobs should not count against customer export quota. create an internal pool with rate-limits and allow ops to request temporary spikes for legal backfills. also emit X-Export-RateLimit headers during manifest generation to surface to UI.

mei: security/PII: tenants may request pseudonymization. manifest should contain `resolved_pseudonym` (HMAC with tenant salt) instead of raw identifiers when tenant flag pii_mode=pseudonymize. include `pii_mode` in manifest top-level metadata.

tariq: for migrations: we should support a `generate-manifest` API for historical bundles that will run the same background resolution but bill differently / rate-limited. legal can request a backfill job and ops will approve.

lucy: signing detail: manifest content = canonical JSON sorted keys -> SHA256 -> signed token. store signature in export metadata and embed public-key fingerprint in the manifest. ensures tamper-evidence.

kevin: implementation sketch:
```
POST /exports { tenant, range, actor_resolution: 'manifest' }
export-worker: stream rows -> write ndjson with actor_raw
when finished: spawn manifest-worker -> dedup actor_raw -> batch lookup -> write manifest_v1.json -> sign -> update export record
```

mei: console: add an affordance to re-run resolution for a bundle (rate-limited) and a CTA for download manifest. show small timeline entry if manifest changed after initial download.

identity-svc: also recommend a `resolver_version` header so we can track mapping drift over time. if future resolver updates produce different resolved ids, we can surface that as a manifest diff.

ci-bot: CI note: scheduled canary deploy export-manifest-worker:v1 -> staging (tenants: 5) -> smoke: manifest signature validation, pseudonymization flag, batch lookup dry-run.

tariq: next actions:
- kevin: add batch lookup endpoint + internal quota (ETA 4d)
- lucy: schema for manifest + signing spec + RFC (ETA 3d)
- mei: console states + copy + re-run CTA (ETA 2d)
- me: legal migration flow + generate-manifest API doc (ETA 3d)

mei: i'll also add telemetry dashboards mock so we can watch identity_api_calls and unresolved trends during canary.

tariq: objections? otherwise i'll open tracking issue REDWOOD-EXPORTS-901 and mark RFC draft. :thumbsup:

kevin: no objections from infra. one ask: define deterministic tie-breaker when multiple hints exist (prefer explicit user header > actor_hint > last-seen mapping).

lucy: documented. also add an audit entry whenever a manifest resolution changes an exported mapping (so compliance has a trace).

ci-bot: created REDWOOD-EXPORTS-901 (manifest-resolution-flow) assigned to lucy.

tariq: thanks all, closing thread.
